Streetwear / 03

OffsetDenim jacket

↑ Compare eight

12.5 oz rigid cotton denim, softly washed without distress holesWashed mid-indigo / tobacco / ecru

Cropped boxy trucker with a straight pointed collar, six brushed nickel shank buttons, twin rectangular chest pockets with squared button flaps, vertical front panel seams and a clean horizontal rear yoke. Two-piece sleeves, button cuffs, rear hem adjuster tabs; tonal topstitch.

Ecru crew tee; matching wide straight jeans, five pockets and back yoke. Dark chocolate leather low-profile lace-up shoes.

Review notes & casting

Adult male 28; distinctive high cheekbones, deep brown skin, tall lean build, wide-set dark eyes. Very short sculpted afro, clean shaven.

Front. Visible pass: distinct cropped trucker and wide denim; plausible grain, collar, button and pocket construction; strong adult casting; square Front, natural fingers, complete head and shoes, neutral white studio. Six-button placket and twin flaps readable. No historical image inputs.

Back. True rear pass: same short afro, wash, cropped boxy body, yoke, two vertical panels and button hem tabs; jeans rear yoke and two patch pockets, shoes viewed from heel. No mirrored front. Complete silhouette.

Editorial. Campaign pass: real long walking stride and natural jacket touch, not static Front duplicate. Facial identity, afro, ecru tee, denim wash, chest flaps, button placket and chocolate shoes consistent. Natural limb overlap; full frame.

Ice-blue singlet; graphite split shorts; white quarter socks. Ice-white mesh cushioned running shoes with restrained pale-lime heel.

Review notes & casting

Adult male 27; deep brown skin, narrow oval face, lean distance-runner frame, long limbs. Close cropped black hair, clean shaven.

Front. Visible pass: lightweight perforated ice-blue singlet, bound armholes, short split running bottoms, cushioned mesh shoes and credible athletic casting. Back. True rear pass: racerback straps logically join front, consistent perforation and binding, graphite split shorts have one narrow rear zip and no invented bulky pockets. Hair, runner physique, socks and pale-lime shoe heels match. Complete silhouette and neutral white.

Editorial. Performance campaign pass: light running stride, correct opposing arm and leg, relaxed hands, landing foot and lifted rear shoe entirely framed. Same face, hair, singlet perforation and lime bar, split shorts, socks and shoes. Subtle plausible moving textile folds.

Review notes & casting

Adult male 32; warm medium-brown skin, long face, pronounced cheekbones, almond dark eyes, lean tall build. Straight dark shoulder-length hair neatly tucked behind ears, clean shaven.

Long straight-haired adult model distinct. Accepted as-rendered below-knee length and eight-button double-breasted arrangement, replacing mid-calf six-button intent. Slate trousers and black boots coherent; white studio and complete frame pass.

Back. True rear pass: same straight shoulder-length hair, cool-stone gabardine and coat length; horizontal storm shield, centre inverted pleat/vent, belt loops, epaulettes, raglan sleeves and cuff buckles plausible. No front buttons on back. Slate trouser and black boot heels consistent.

Editorial. Outerwear campaign pass: purposeful walking step and natural lapel touch, subtle hem movement, same face and straight hair, coat overlap, button arrangement, buckled belt and cuffs. Hand partially overlaps storm flap in Editorial; full flap remains inspectable in Front. Complete boots and head.
